name: Review B.10 example: Kochi agency charges medical, attestation and a service charge after visa stamping

inputs.title: PHP Developer – Riyadh
inputs.description: Urgent requirement for PHP Developers for a reputed company in Riyadh. Salary SAR 6000 + accommodation. Candidates must pay medical test charges INR 6,500 and attestation charges INR 12,000 to our Kochi office. Service charge after visa stamping. Offer letter after payment.
